name: qfd_ctrl_pc_19_m5-m5-COMMIT
purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed qfd_ctrl_ready_hbm_19-3d5ad2a4ftt (qfd_ctrl_pc_19, RTL 3d5ad2a4f, snapshot of 4 drifted files): same RTL, outline 247.536x370.44, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:qwen-blocks

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qwen_ctrl_pc_head #(.ENABLE(1), .PC(19)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv physical/ref_tile/qfd_ctrl_pc_19_m5/src/rtl/physical/ot_qwen_ctrl_pc_head.sv physical/ref_tile/qfd_ctrl_pc_19_m5/src/rtl/physical/ot_hbm_r14_stream_pc_ready.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: ctrl_exact
bench.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/qfd_ctrl_pc_19_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/qfd_ctrl_pc_19_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -s tb_qwen_ctrl_pc -P tb_qwen_ctrl_pc.PC=19 -P tb_qwen_ctrl_pc.NEG=0 -o {RUN}/bench/ctrl0 rtl/test/tb_qwen_ctrl_pc_head.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_ctrl_pc_head.sv rtl/model_ready_hbm_r14/ot_hbm_r14_stream_pc.sv rtl/physical/ot_hbm_r14_stream_pc_ready.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/ctrl0
}
bench.note: [m5rr: run on the 3d5ad2a4f snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/qfd_ctrl_pc_19_m5/src]

bench.name: ctrl_mutant
bench.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_1; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/qfd_ctrl_pc_19_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/qfd_ctrl_pc_19_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -s tb_qwen_ctrl_pc -P tb_qwen_ctrl_pc.PC=19 -P tb_qwen_ctrl_pc.NEG=1 -o {RUN}/bench/ctrl1 rtl/test/tb_qwen_ctrl_pc_head.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_ctrl_pc_head.sv rtl/model_ready_hbm_r14/ot_hbm_r14_stream_pc.sv rtl/physical/ot_hbm_r14_stream_pc_ready.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/ctrl1
}
bench.note: [m5rr: run on the 3d5ad2a4f snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/qfd_ctrl_pc_19_m5/src]

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_ctrl_pc_19_m5/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_ctrl_pc_19_m5/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_ctrl_pc_19_m5 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qwen_ctrl_pc_head  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
